problems.title: 数气：最后一口
problems.goal: 黑先，在一手内提掉白子。
problems.goal_en: Black to play and capture the white stone in one move.

hints.value: 先数一数中央白子的气。

hints_en.value: First count the liberties of the white stone in the center.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 数气：两子一气
problems.title_en: Count Liberties: Two Stones, One Liberty
problems.goal: 白先，找到黑棋两子的最后一口气。
problems.goal_en: White to play. Find the last liberty of the two connected black stones.

hints.value: 连在一起的棋子要作为一个整体数气。

hints_en.value: Treat connected stones as one group when counting liberties.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 数气：拐弯三子
problems.goal: 黑先，提掉拐弯相连的三颗白子。
problems.goal_en: Black to play and capture the three connected white stones around the bend.

hints.value: 三颗白子彼此相连，共用同一口气。

hints_en.value: The three white stones are connected and share one final liberty.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 数气：直线三子
problems.title_en: Count Liberties: Three in a Row
problems.goal: 白先，找到黑棋直线三子的最后一气。
problems.goal_en: White to play. Find the last liberty of the three black stones in a row.

hints.value: 沿着黑棋外圈逐点检查空位。

hints_en.value: Check every empty point around the outside of the black group.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 打吃：两个方向
problems.goal: 黑先，用一手把白子打成只剩一气。
problems.goal_en: Black to play. Put the white stone in atari with one move.

hints.value: 白子现在有两口气，堵住任意一口即可打吃。

hints_en.value: White has two liberties. Filling either one gives atari.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 打吃：角部的两口气
problems.goal: 白先，在角部打吃黑子。
problems.goal_en: White to play and put the black corner stone in atari.

hints.value: 左侧和上侧已被白棋堵住，只数剩下的相邻空点。

hints_en.value: The left and upper sides are blocked by white; count only the remaining adjacent empty points.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 打吃：相连两子
problems.goal: 黑先，把相连的两颗白子打吃。
problems.goal_en: Black to play and put the two connected white stones in atari.

hints.value: 两颗白子只剩下两口公共的气。

hints_en.value: The two white stones have only two shared liberties.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 打吃：横向两子
problems.goal: 白先，选择一口气把黑棋两子打吃。
problems.goal_en: White to play. Choose one liberty to put the two black stones in atari.

hints.value: 黑棋两子还剩两个相邻空点。

hints_en.value: The two black stones have two adjacent empty points left.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 提子：角部两子
problems.goal: 黑先，提掉角上的两颗白子。
problems.goal_en: Black to play and capture the two white stones in the corner.

hints.value: 棋盘边缘也会封住棋子的气。

hints_en.value: The edge of the board also takes away liberties.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 提子：边上两子
problems.goal: 白先，收紧黑棋在上边的最后一气。
problems.goal_en: White to play and fill the last liberty of the black stones on the upper edge.

hints.value: 不要把棋盘外误算成气。

hints_en.value: Points outside the board are not liberties.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 提子：四子方块
problems.goal: 黑先，一手提掉白棋四子。
problems.goal_en: Black to play and capture the four white stones in one move.

hints.value: 方块四子看起来很厚，但现在只剩一口气。

hints_en.value: The four-stone square looks solid, but it has only one liberty left.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 提子：角部曲三
problems.title_en: Capture: Bent Three in the Corner
problems.goal: 白先，找到三颗黑子的共同最后一气。
problems.goal_en: White to play. Find the shared last liberty of the three black stones.

hints.value: 黑棋虽然拐弯，但三子仍是一个整体。

hints_en.value: Although they bend around the corner, the three black stones form one group.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 逃出打吃：伸一手
problems.goal: 黑先，救出被打吃的单子。
problems.goal_en: Black to play and save the stone in atari.

hints.value: 从唯一的气上向外延伸。

hints_en.value: Extend outward from its only liberty.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 逃出打吃：两子一起跑
problems.goal: 白先，让被打吃的两颗白子增加气。
problems.goal_en: White to play and give the two white stones more liberties.

hints.value: 两颗白子只能从同一个方向逃出。

hints_en.value: The two white stones can escape in only one direction.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 逃出打吃：角部出路
problems.goal: 黑先，救出角上的黑子。
problems.goal_en: Black to play and save the black stone in the corner.

hints.value: 角上只剩沿着边线的一条路。

hints_en.value: In the corner, there is only one route out along the edge.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 逃出打吃：边上转身
problems.title_en: Escape Atari: Turn on the Edge
problems.goal: 白先，救出上边相连的两颗白子。
problems.goal_en: White to play and save the two connected white stones on the upper edge.

hints.value: 寻找棋块唯一还能落子的气。

hints_en.value: Find the group's only playable liberty.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 连接：补上断点
problems.goal: 黑先，把上下两块黑棋连成一块。
problems.goal_en: Black to play and connect the upper and lower black groups.

hints.value: 找到两块黑棋共同相邻的空点。

hints_en.value: Find the empty point adjacent to both black groups.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 连接：右边的缺口
problems.goal: 白先，补住两块白棋之间的缺口。
problems.goal_en: White to play and fill the gap between the two white groups.

hints.value: 白棋上下两部分只差中间一手。

hints_en.value: Only one move in the middle separates the upper and lower white stones.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 切断：十字路口
problems.goal: 黑先，抢占断点，不让上下白棋连接。
problems.goal_en: Black to play. Take the cutting point before the white stones connect.

hints.value: 连接点也正是切断点。

hints_en.value: The connecting point is also the cutting point.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 切断：横向断点
problems.goal: 白先，切断左右两颗黑子。
problems.goal_en: White to play and separate the two black stones.

hints.value: 落在两颗黑子之间，同时与白棋接应。

hints_en.value: Play between the two black stones while connecting to white support.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 做活：一手分成两眼
problems.goal: 黑先，把内部空间分成两个独立的眼。
problems.goal_en: Black to play and divide the inside space into two separate eyes.

hints.value: 三个连续空点要用中间一点分开。

hints_en.value: Split the three consecutive empty points by playing in the middle.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 做活：白棋两眼
problems.goal: 白先，将眼位分隔开，做出两只真眼。
problems.goal_en: White to play. Divide the eye space to make two true eyes.

hints.value: 占住内部三个空点的正中央。

hints_en.value: Play at the center of the three internal empty points.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 假眼：白棋破眼
problems.goal: 白先，走进看似不能落子的眼位。
problems.goal_en: White to play inside the eye point that looks unplayable.

hints.value: 先检查围住眼位的黑子是否正被打吃。

hints_en.value: First check whether the black stones around the eye are in atari.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors

problems.title: 假眼：黑棋破眼
problems.goal: 黑先，识破白棋的假眼并落进去。
problems.goal_en: Black to play. See through White's false eye and play inside.

hints.value: 眼位旁的白子只剩中央这一口气。

hints_en.value: The white stone beside the eye has only this central liberty left.

problems.author: KataGo HandTalk contributors
